# Anas Tanveer — Full-Stack Web Developer (Dubai, UAE)

> Anas Tanveer is a full-stack web developer based in Dubai, UAE with 7+ years of
> experience building Laravel applications, WordPress business websites, Shopify
> stores, custom dashboards, SaaS platforms, APIs and SEO-ready systems for clients
> across the UAE, UK and Canada. He operates through ARS Developer Ltd (UK) and
> serves businesses that need reliable, maintainable, conversion-focused web systems.
